result.title: LeAVJEPA: A Minimalist Architecture for Audio-Visual Self-Supervised Learning
result.summary: Prior audio-visual self-supervised learning methods rely on mechanisms such as EMA target encoders, prediction heads, reconstruction decoders, and contrastive losses. We introduce LeAVJEPA, the first audio-visual encoder trained under LeJEPA's collapse-free objective. A single early-fusion Vision Transformer processes audio, video, and joint audio-video inputs. Modality dropout treats a missing modality as another view of the same event, making cross-modal alignment implicit in the objective. The model aligns global embeddings with modality-specific local embeddings, and SIGReg prevents representational collapse. A controlled ablation identifies modality dropout as the key mechanism for audio-visual alignment. Despite the architectural simplicity, LeAVJEPA reaches 36.0 mAP on AudioSet-20K and 91.3% accuracy on ESC-50 under frozen evaluation. After fine-tuning, it reaches 61.1% accuracy on VGGSound, and its embeddings support zero-shot audio-visual retrieval.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 LeAVJEPA，一个极简的音视频自监督编码器：用单个早期融合 ViT 处理音频、视频及联合输入，以模态 dropout 把缺失模态当作同一事件的另一视图，并借 SIGReg 防止表示坍缩，在多项音视频任务上取得竞争性结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「模态 dropout 视缺失模态为同一事件的另一视图」与崩溃防止正则化，可能启发 LVR 中视觉旁路、跨模态证据融合及 latent 状态防坍缩的设计，值得核查其表示是否真正保留模态特定信息。
